title: TensorPlate Agent Config
description: Runtime configuration for `tensorplate-agent` (V01-E08). The agent loads this file at startup, validates it before opening the local control transport, and refuses to mutate durable state until validation succeeds.

allOf.$comment: transport defaults to unix_socket, so an ABSENT transport also requires socket_path. Without the anyOf the default case slips through and a schema-valid config fails at startup.
The loopback restriction applies to the host actually bound. Under a unix socket the value is unused and the runtime never reads it, so rejecting a leftover here would refuse a config that starts.

transport.description: Local control API transport. v0.1.0 default: Unix domain socket. Loopback HTTP is reserved for environments where UDS is unavailable; the agent records the decision rationale in logs at startup.

socket_path.description: Filesystem path for the Unix domain socket. Required when transport is `unix_socket`.

tcp_bind_host.description: Loopback literal only, enforced under `loopback_tcp` where it is actually bound. The agent refuses any other host: the control API is local-only, and binding it wider is not a configuration this release serves.

state_dir.description: Absolute directory where the durable state file lives. Created if missing.

staging_dir.description: Absolute directory where deploy transactions stage verified bundles. Each deployment lives under `<staging_dir>/<deployment_id>/`.

available_backends.description: Backends the agent will accept in a bundle's `backend_hint`. The agent does not infer availability heuristically; this list is sourced from `tensorplate doctor` output in production.

backend_capabilities.description: Capability flags published by each available backend. The agent consults this map when a bundle declares `capability_requirements`. Missing entries are treated as no-capability-published.

device_memory_bytes.description: Total device/system memory available to the runtime. Used by the capacity_checked phase to reject bundles whose memory estimate exceeds capacity.

admission_posture.description: How strictly this machine must be judged before a deploy is admitted. Omit to let the matched platform row's own floor decide. A value here can only make admission stricter: it is resolved as the maximum of this and the row's floor, so an edge row's requirement cannot be switched off by configuration. An unrecognised value is a startup error, not a silent fallback.

runtime_version.description: Runtime version this config was written for. Normally absent: the agent fills it in at load with its own version, and it is recorded rather than matched.

worker.$comment: mode=process spawns a binary, so the path is required there and only there. The default is mock, which needs none.

mode.description: `mock` uses the deterministic in-process worker for host CI. `process` spawns and supervises the V01-E07 tensorplate-serving binary.

serving_binary_path.description: Absolute path to tensorplate-serving. Required when worker.mode=process.

serving_bind_host.description: Loopback host used for process-backed serving workers.

serving_bind_port.description: Primary loopback port used by the process-backed worker.

serving_candidate_bind_port.description: Alternate loopback port used while warming a replacement candidate.

serving_use_mock_session.description: Pass deployment.use_mock_session=true to tensorplate-serving while still exercising the process boundary.

serving_config_dir.description: Absolute directory where agent-rendered serving-worker configs are written. Defaults to state_dir/worker-configs.

supervision.description: V01-E09 worker supervisor config. Independent of `worker.*`: `worker.*` controls the prepare/warm/promote IPC contract; `supervision.*` controls the agent-owned worker process lifecycle (launch, stop, restart backoff, crash-loop policy).

binary_path.description: Absolute path to the tensorplate-serving binary the supervisor launches. Validated before any process start.

env_allowlist.description: Names of environment variables forwarded from the agent's environment. Empty disables env forwarding.

working_dir.description: Absolute working directory the launched process inherits.

serving_config_path.description: Absolute serving config the supervisor passes via `--config`.

control_host.description: Loopback host the worker binds its data plane to.

restart_policy.$comment: kind defaults to bounded_backoff, so an ABSENT kind takes the bounds too. Disabled skips the block in the runtime, and constraining it here would reject a config that starts.

backoff.description: Bounded exponential-backoff parameters with a rolling-window crash-loop detector. All timing uses monotonic time. Bounds are enforced only where the policy uses them: `RestartPolicyKind::Disabled` skips this block entirely, so a leftover value there must not fail validation.

event_sink.description: Bounded supervision-event sink config (V01-E09-F05). The sink never blocks the supervisor; events drop oldest-first when the queue is full.

uds_path.description: Optional Unix domain socket the observability service listens on. v0.1.0 default is in-process only; V01-E10 lights up the UDS path.
